messages:
alex-sales: Quick help needed — enterprise POC on Dedicated failing JSON parse when they do two function calls back-to-back with streaming enabled. Demo tomorrow, they're blocked.

mike-eng: Short details? model, stream flag, request ids?

alex-sales: Model: rwd-compat-7b-v3, stream=true, json_mode=true. Request ids: r_aa112 and r_bb113. Client error: `json.decoder.JSONDecodeError: Extra data` on client-side after stream completes.

priya-ml: Likely case of multiple top-level JSON objects emitted into one TCP stream. If a 429 or quota chunk interrupts, client concatenates and fails.

emma-se: Customer also asked whether intermediate tool outputs are persisted. They must show in QSA that nothing is written to persistent shared storage during inference.

rate-bot: rate-limiter: customer-eco-9 - qps_alloc: 15 used: 15 reset_in: 9s

mike-eng: Traces (trace: tr-2026-03-20-77) show: toolA responded OK chunked, then toolB received a 429 and returned a short error chunk. Client treated the whole stream as one JSON doc.

priya-ml: Immediate mitigations: (1) set `stream=false` per-request for the POC so client gets a single complete JSON payload; (2) update client to parse NDJSON or length-prefixed JSON if streaming is required. We'll share an SDK example.

emma-se: For the QSA: Dedicated nodes keep tool outputs in-memory per request only; default config does not persist tool outputs. Customer-managed KMS available. I'll draft a short note.

alex-sales: Also they're seeing weird replacement chars (\uFFFD) and sometimes a BOM at start of the second tool output. Could be vendor upstream returning UTF-8 with BOM.

priya-ml: We can strip BOM on ingest in SDK/runtime; small change `if bytes.startswith(b"\xEF\xBB\xBF"): bytes = bytes[3:]`. I'll open a PR and queue a staging canary.

mike-eng: Longer term: runtime should frame tool responses explicitly when streaming to avoid ambiguous concatenation. I'll log a bug and add tests for interleaved chunks.

alex-sales: OK I'll tell the customer: (A) temp workaround: stream=false (per-request flag); (B) ops can bump QPS for demo if needed; (C) we're pushing a BOM-strip patch to staging — ETA ~3-4h. Scheduling call at 10:00 PT.

emma-se: Ping me for QSA approval once you have the draft.

alex-sales: Thanks team — will relay and confirm after staging smoke. :white_check_mark:
